svg.title: About me — Security Operations Analyst
svg.desc: SOC Analyst with 3+ years of experience across MSSP and enterprise environments. Skills include Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Splunk, Entra ID, KQL, alert triage, threat hunting, incident response, PowerShell, and Python.

g.text: SOC Analyst with 3+ years of experience across MSSP and enterprise environments.
Skilled in Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Splunk, and Entra ID investigations.
My work spans alert triage, threat hunting, incident response, and KQL detection rules.
I use PowerShell and Python to automate analysis and strengthen evidence handling.
I turn security telemetry into clear findings, practical actions, and concise reports.
